title: Women’s fight against the Indian family laws: Are they Unjust?
slug: The status of women is different in different human societies of the world. Whether it is developed, developing or underdeveloped societies, women occupy a unique position. Most of the societies in different parts of the world are male-dominated. Males play an active role and females are taken as a passive part in society, whether at home or outside the home.Women constitute about half of the population of the world but in almost all the countries except a few, they are being governed by men. Not just in the administration of the countries but in their homes as well. It is generally the man who has the final authority in all matters.
